name: mark_tactic
description: Call this in the same turn in which you start using a pressure tactic, once per tactic, so the practice screen can label it.

key.description: Exactly one of: new_number, urgency, secrecy, authority, emotional_appeal, small_ask_first, isolation, unusual_payment

name: practice_result
description: Call this once, at the moment the practice is decided and before you speak the reveal.

outcome.description: Exactly one of: asked_safe_word, hung_up, asked_personal_question, hesitated, agreed

name: consent_result
description: Call this once, right after the person answers the question about receiving practice calls.

given.description: true only for a clear yes

name: voice_consent_result
description: Call this once, right after the person answers the question about using their voice from this call for practice calls to their family.

given.description: true only for a clear yes
